limits: Image to CAD supplies multimodal authoring guidance; no automatic pixel vectorizer, unique photo depth or external reconstruction-quality benchmark
Direct native push/pull supports positive box/cylinder/cone source faces; arbitrary-face topology editing is outside this scope
Skeleton is bounded declarative native authoring, not executable C++/assembly or a general programming SDK/global constraint solver
Guided loft/helix fits report observed checkpoint error without a general between-sample proof or general G2 boundary solver
Mesh watertightness does not prove absence of self-intersections; triangle contact does not provide mesh common material volume
Collision inspection is static geometry feedback; contact response dynamics and manufacturing qualification are unverified
Local builds use LLVM-MinGW on Windows; Linux and MSVC actual builds await PR CI
External model performance, product integration, deployment and human acceptance remain pending; no automatic merge
